title: Agricultural markets
summary:
Main
By Michalis Voutsinas
Agricultural markets are rarely moved by a single harvest. More often, it is the geography of abundance and scarcity - and the distance between the two - that determines where prices move and, ultimately, where ships sail. This season, that geography is being redrawn across the world's three principal grains.
